answer: Re-attestations are stored in yarrow and juniper lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the tundra graph. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1010 impostors cost 226 times the honest price and take 15 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
